_player_base_kits._note: M28 — the PER-PATHWAY player base-kit table (the one net-new eng seam). AbilityDB.kit_for('player') resolves the run's pathway (Progression.pathway()) through THIS table: a pathway authored here SWAPS the base kit; a pathway NOT listed (hunter — the slice default) falls back to the 'player' form's kit below, UNCHANGED, so the Hunter base kit and the pinned combat_sim/full_run staging stay byte-identical. Engine-neutral: a data table keyed by pathway string, no NPC/id branch. This is NOT a combat_form (AbilityDB skips the leading-underscore key in the form loop).

player._note: M22 B8: pistol_whip is the ammo-free MELEE FLOOR (a free strike) — a dry (0-round) player can always chip hp with it, so ammo starvation is no longer an unrecoverable soft-loss. It is APPENDED last so it never displaces revolver_shot as the primary-attack pick (PlayerCombat._primary_attack_id returns revolver_shot for the player form regardless); the melee floor is fired by its own `melee` input binding.

cult_guard._note: N6 (asset polish B3) — the Ritual Night crypt door DEFENDERS' own human-phase form (scenario.json ritual_night.defender_form points here; RitualNight stages the roster from that data, no engine id branch). Previously they wore butcher_human — bram_kell's hidden-Beyonder phase — which (a) rendered ARTLESS placeholder icons in the crypt (no enemies/butcher_human.png) and (b) carried his assume_form -> bieber_monster reflex, so a pressed door guard could shed into THE butcher's unique beast. This row keeps the same cleaver_swipe pressure and dodge reflex, drops the transform, and wears the shipped cult_thrall painting via the N4 `sprite` alias (they ARE the cultists the backlash tears into thralls — same robes, same face). NOT monster (Doom counts only real monsters), NOT hidden_beyonder (no prey lead points at a door guard).

cult_thrall._note: M7 Ritual Night backlash — an interrupted celebrant LOSES CONTROL (canon summoning §⑦) and assume_forms into this thrall. A monster form (so the Doom driver counts it) with the butcher's cleaver kit; no assume_form of its own (a thrall is the terminal shape, not a two-stage descent).

descended_avatar._note: M7 Ritual Night boss — the avatar HALF-LANDS when the fuse crosses the low threshold (§9 'kill the avatar before full descent'). Two-stage descent: at low HP its hp_below reflex casts avatar_ascend -> descended_avatar_true, exactly like bram_kell/butcher_human's assume_form seam. A monster form.

beyond_hunter._note: M11 Notice teeth — the Attention of the Beyond made flesh. When Notice crosses its high threshold (Meters.threat_threshold 'notice'), MeterThreats spawns ONE agent wearing this form, in_combat with combat_intent engage->player, so the tactical layer pursues + attacks the investigator. A MONSTER form (Beyond-touched / unknown-corrupted, canon: a corrupted unknown thing — NOT a Nighthawk), so the Doom 'monsters left alive' driver ALSO counts it while it stalks. Aggressive melee-charge kit reused from the built monster arts; an hp_below frenzy so it presses the kill. No assume_form of its own (it is the terminal hunter shape). Numbers are TUNING placeholders.

announce._note: N4 — the diegetic threat-lifecycle toast copy (Toasts consumes threat_dispatched/threat_resolved and reads THIS row via the event's form; the engine holds no threat literal).

nighthawk_pursuer._note: M11 Heat teeth — an official Evernight Beyonder (a Nighthawk) dispatched when Heat crosses its high threshold (Meters.threat_threshold 'heat'). Spawned by MeterThreats as ONE agent, in_combat with combat_intent engage->player, so the tactical layer hunts the investigator. NOT a monster form — the Nighthawks are HUMAN officials (the player's nominal allies' faction; being hunted by them is the cost of public power), so this is deliberately absent 'monster' and does NOT feed the Doom monster driver. A disciplined ranged-first kit (revolver + a movement dash) with a cautious style so it keeps distance and paces its shots — engine-neutral, no morality branch. Numbers are TUNING placeholders.

wren_human._note: M12 — the SECOND adversary's HUMAN phase-1 form (sable_wren, a Hunter-pathway Beyonder who LOST CONTROL from a bad over-ingestion). Mirrors butcher_human's two-phase shape but with a DISTINCT, DISTANCE-first Hunter kit (canon direction v2 §6: guns -> fire -> blood-fury): she opens at range with a revolver + brands her quarry with mark_prey (the Provoker's tracking mark), NOT the butcher's melee cleaver. Her hp_below reflex casts shed_the_hunt (NOT assume_form) -> wren_predator, the feral monster shape — the same descent seam bram_kell uses, a different destination. A telegraph->dodge reflex gives readable counterplay; cautious default_style so she keeps distance and paces her shots (a gunman, not a brawler). Numbers are TUNING placeholders.

wren_predator._note: M12 — the SECOND adversary's MONSTER phase-2 form (sable_wren's feral blood-hunter shape, reached only via wren_human's hp_below -> shed_the_hunt). monster:true so the Doom 'monsters left alive' driver counts her. A DISTINCT kit from the butcher's bieber_monster cleaver set: this is the Hunter pathway's fire+blood-fury endgame (direction v2 §6) — a phosphor incendiary round that burns, a thrown hook to pin fleeing prey at range, a charge to close, and a self-worked blood_frenzy that quickens every following blow. A ranged/berserk blood-hunter, NOT a melee brawler. An hp_below reflex fires blood_frenzy so she presses the kill; a telegraph->dodge reflex keeps her evasive. No further transform (this is the terminal hunter shape — the executor's self-loop guard makes any future hp_below row safe). Numbers are TUNING placeholders.

mack_harbor._note: M14 — the THIRD adversary's HUMAN phase-1 form (leland_mack, a Hunter-pathway Beyonder who LOST CONTROL from over-ingesting a Red-Priest potion). DISTINCT in fiction and fight from both the butcher (melee cleaver) and Wren (ranged revolver): Mack is a mid-range hook-and-charge bruiser — he CLOSES with charge (the bull-rush lunge) and pins prey at range with hook_throw to slow them, applies mark_prey for the tracking mark, uses dash to reposition, and transforms via lose_the_line (his own transform row, distinct destination mack_beast — the same descent seam). Kit advantage over Wren: charge (22 dmg, 4s CD) + hook_throw (14 dmg, 5s CD) stack more damage than Wren's human hook alone — combined with 200 HP vs Wren's 100, Mack is HARDER to bring down before the transform. His hp_below transform fires at 0.45 (vs Wren's 0.5): on a 200-HP pool the transform fires at <=90 HP, a narrower band than Wren's 50 HP absolute trigger — the player has LESS time in the readable human phase before the beast emerges. An aggressive default_style (a bruiser, not a cautious gunman like Wren). A telegraph->dodge reflex with 230ms delay (vs Wren's 200ms: marginally slower, balanced by the charge close distance and higher HP). TUNING: harder than Wren through raw survivability + charge melee, not just kit variety.

mack_beast._note: M14 — the THIRD adversary's MONSTER phase-2 form (leland_mack's feral harbour beast, reached only via mack_harbor's hp_below -> lose_the_line). monster:true so the Doom 'monsters left alive' driver counts him. A DISTINCT kit from BOTH the butcher's bieber_monster (cleaver_swipe melee) AND Wren's wren_predator (incendiary_round / blood-hunter): this is a grapple-and-lunge harbour beast — hook_throw to snare prey at range, charge to close and slam, blood_frenzy to quicken the kill. NO cleaver_swipe (distinct from butcher), NO incendiary_round (distinct from Wren). An aggressive style; the hp_below blood_frenzy fires at 0.25 (vs Wren's 0.3: less room to breathe, HARDER). TUNING: higher poise via charge (55) + hook slow keeps the player from kiting freely — the Seq-8 meal fights meaner than the Seq-9 Wren. A telegraph->dodge reflex with shorter delay (210ms vs Wren's 220ms: faster reactions). Numbers are TUNING placeholders — the combat_sim Scenario F proves the two-phase fight resolves deterministically.

neil_human._note: M28 — old_neil's HUMAN phase-1 form (a Hermit-pathway Beyonder who LOST CONTROL to the Hidden Sage's whispers while trying to resurrect Celeste). Mirrors wren_human's two-phase shape (hidden_beyonder:true + an hp_below transform reflex) but with a DISTINCT HERMIT ritual/astrology kit: he opens at range with the star-brand + wards the ground with ward_circle, NOT a revolver or a cleaver. His hp_below(0.5) reflex casts neil_descend -> neil_monster — the same descent seam bram_kell/sable_wren use, a different destination. A telegraph->dodge reflex gives readable counterplay; cautious default_style (a caster keeps his distance). TUNING placeholders.

neil_monster._note: M28 — old_neil's MONSTER phase-2 form (the Hidden Sage's pollution wearing what is left of the alchemist), reached only via neil_human's hp_below -> neil_descend. monster:true so the Doom 'monsters left alive' driver counts it. A DISTINCT kit from every Hunter monster (no cleaver_swipe, no revolver_shot, no incendiary_round): the Hermit's star/ritual endgame — collapsing_star (the wide AoE burst), star_brand, and astral_chains (a binding stun). An aggressive style; an hp_below(0.3) reflex presses with collapsing_star. A telegraph->dodge reflex keeps it evasive. No further transform (the terminal shape — the executor self-loop guard makes any future hp_below row safe). TUNING placeholders — combat_sim Scenario G proves the two-phase fight resolves deterministically.

finch_human._note: M30 — ledger_finch's HUMAN phase-1 form (the SECOND Hermit-pathway prey, the Seq-8 meal; direction v2 §6). A university records clerk who stole a restricted forbidden volume and LOST CONTROL reading it — mirrors neil_human's two-phase shape (hidden_beyonder:true + an hp_below transform reflex) but fights her OWN Hermit word/ink kit: she opens at range with forbidden_recitation and binds with the redacted name, NOT neil's star_brand/ward_circle (so finch is a distinct hunt, not a neil re-skin). Her hp_below(0.5) reflex casts finch_descend -> finch_monster — the same descent seam bram_kell/sable_wren/old_neil use, a different destination. A telegraph->dodge reflex gives readable counterplay; cautious default_style (a caster keeps her distance). TUNING placeholders.

finch_monster._note: M30 — ledger_finch's MONSTER phase-2 form (the forbidden volume wearing what is left of the clerk), reached only via finch_human's hp_below -> finch_descend. monster:true so the Doom 'monsters left alive' driver counts it once she has transformed. A DISTINCT kit from EVERY Hunter monster (no cleaver_swipe/revolver_shot/incendiary_round) AND from neil_monster (which fights collapsing_star/star_brand/astral_chains): finch's endgame is her OWN ink/word set — ink_flood (the wide AoE burst), redacted_word (the binding stun), forbidden_recitation (the aimed word-bolt). NO art shared with neil_monster, so the two Hermit prey fight differently. An aggressive style; an hp_below(0.3) reflex presses with ink_flood. A telegraph->dodge reflex keeps it evasive. No further transform (the terminal shape — the executor self-loop guard makes any future hp_below row safe). The body sprite follows the assets/enemies/<form>.png convention (finch_monster.png, generated separately); the form works with the placeholder if the png is absent (CombatExecutor._apply_form_sprite no-ops on a missing file). TUNING placeholders.

auber_human._note: M_death — sister_auber's HUMAN phase-1 form (the Death pathway's Seq-9 prey; canon: Corpse Collector line, grave-power). Mirrors neil_human's two-phase shape (hidden_beyonder + hp_below transform) with the Death censer/grave kit — she opens at range with censer_ember and wards ground with grave_ring, NOT a star-brand or a revolver. hp_below(0.5) -> auber_descend -> auber_monster (the same descent seam, a different destination). Cautious (a caster keeps her distance); telegraph->dodge for readable counterplay. TUNING placeholders.

auber_monster._note: M_death — sister_auber's MONSTER phase-2 form (the grave-power wearing what is left of the lay-sister), reached only via auber_human's hp_below -> auber_descend. monster:true so the Doom driver counts it once transformed. DISTINCT kit from every Hunter monster (no cleaver/revolver/incendiary) AND from both Hermit monsters (no star_brand/collapsing_star/astral_chains, no ink_flood/redacted_word/finch_recite): the Death grave/spirit endgame — wailing_host (wide AoE burst), censer_ember, grave_hands (binding stun). These ARE the arts the Death player later earns (the neil_monster pattern). Aggressive; hp_below(0.3) presses with wailing_host. Terminal shape (executor self-loop guard). Body sprite assets/enemies/auber_monster.png (staged art); works with placeholder if absent (CombatExecutor._apply_form_sprite no-ops). TUNING placeholders.

cassian_human._note: M_death — brother_cassian's HUMAN phase-1 form (the SECOND Death prey, the Seq-8 meal). His OWN requiem/shroud kit distinct from auber (the finch-vs-neil precedent): requiem_bolt opener + shroud_binding binder. hp_below(0.45) -> cassian_descend -> cassian_monster — TIGHTER than auber's 0.5 and on an AUTHORED 130-HP pool (npcs.json max_hp), so the Seq-8 meal is harder both ways (the mack precedent: survivability + a narrower readable human phase). Cautious; telegraph->dodge. TUNING placeholders.

cassian_monster._note: M_death — brother_cassian's MONSTER phase-2 form (the crypt congregation wearing the curate), reached only via cassian_human's hp_below -> cassian_descend. monster:true. DISTINCT kit from auber_monster (no wailing_host/censer_ember/grave_hands) and every prior monster: choir_of_the_dead (AoE burst), shroud_binding (stun), requiem_bolt (aimed bolt). Aggressive; faster dodge (210ms — meaner reactions, mack_beast precedent); hp_below(0.3) presses with choir_of_the_dead. Terminal shape. Body sprite assets/enemies/cassian_monster.png; placeholder-safe. TUNING placeholders — the combat_sim Scenario J proves the two-phase fight resolves deterministically.

descended_avatar_true._note: M7 Ritual Night — the avatar's TRUER shape (the second stage of the descent). Reached only via descended_avatar's hp_below -> avatar_ascend. Deadlier arc + a charge; no further assume_form (this is the terminal form — the self-loop guard in the executor keeps any future hp_below row from re-casting into itself).
